summary: Patriot Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing that, effective July 6, 2026, holders of its units (each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant) may elect to separately trade the underlying securities. Units not separated continue trading on Nasdaq under PTACU; separated Class A shares and warrants trade under PTAC and PTACW, respectively. No price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine SPAC post-IPO unit separation, not a special-situation event.
